name: bottle_to_bin

phases.name: lift_and_compact
phases.condition: lift measured; native retention and full carrying footprint clear; prefer torso near world-vertical where safely feasible

phases.name: transport
phases.condition: retention and swept collision checks; maintain the closest safely feasible upright torso posture

phases.name: refresh_geometry
phases.condition: current bottle+bin meshes and measured hand/object transform

phases.name: place_and_release
phases.condition: model explicit release=true; reached endpoint before open

phases.name: settle_and_verify
phases.condition: wait90 then Inside+released; wait60 then repeat

model_estimates: each pose or generated phase control_steps positive integer; backend may extend; no100-step cap
acceptance: single bottle Inside and released; whole task separate
